title: WPMS/261/2014 of Manjul Kumar Mittal AND ANOTHER Vs Sharad Lal Sah AND OTHERS

paras.text:
Time Extension Application No. 22 of 2019
In
WPMS No. 261 of 2014
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for
the petitioners.
None present for the respondents.
This case was decided on merits by
this Court vide order dated 03.04.2018.
Now time extension application
has been moved on behalf of the
applicant by which he seeks six month
time to vacate the premises in question.
This Court finds no ground to
grant further time to vacate the
premises in question.
Accordingly, the time extension
application is dismissed.
